{{wowapitype}}
The <code>WOW_PROJECT_ID</code> constants can be used to determine the current client.

==WOW_PROJECT_ID==
<onlyinclude>{| class="sortable darktable zebra col1-center"
! Value !! Constant !! Description !! FrameXML
|-
|  || <code><font color="#ecbc2a">WOW_PROJECT_ID</font></code> || ||
|-
| 1 || <code>WOW_PROJECT_MAINLINE</code> || [[Retail]] || <code class="plainlinks">[https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/10.2.6/Interface/SharedXML/ProjectConstants.lua#L1 ProjectConstants.lua]</code>
|-
| 2 || <code>WOW_PROJECT_CLASSIC</code> || [[Classic Era]]<br>[[World_of_Warcraft:_Classic_20th_Anniversary_Edition|Classic 20th Anniversary]] || <code class="plainlinks">[https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/1.15.2/Interface/SharedXML/ProjectConstants.lua#L2 ProjectConstants.lua]</code>
|-
| 3 || <code>WOW_PROJECT_WOWLABS</code> || [[Plunderstorm]] || <code class="plainlinks">[https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/10.2.6/Interface/SharedXML/WoWLabs/ProjectConstants.lua ProjectConstants.lua]</code>
|-
| 5 || <code>WOW_PROJECT_BURNING_CRUSADE_CLASSIC</code> || [[Burning Crusade Classic]]<br>[[World_of_Warcraft:_Burning_Crusade_Classic_Anniversary_Edition|Burning Crusade Anniversary]] || <code class="plainlinks">[https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/2.5.4/Interface_TBC/FrameXML/Constants.lua#L1046 Constants.lua]</code>
|-
| 11 || <code>WOW_PROJECT_WRATH_CLASSIC</code> || [[Wrath Classic]]<br>[[Titan Reforged - Chrono]] || <code class="plainlinks">[https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/3.80.2/Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_FrameXMLBase/Wrath/Constants.lua#L124 Constants.lua]</code>
|-
| 14 || <code>WOW_PROJECT_CATACLYSM_CLASSIC</code> || [[Cataclysm Classic]] || <code class="plainlinks">[https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/4.4.0/Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_FrameXMLBase/Cata/Constants.lua#L173 Constants.lua]</code>
|-
| 18 || <code>WOW_PROJECT_CAMELOT</code> || [[World of Warcraft: Forever]] || <code class="plainlinks">[https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/blob/1.60.1/Interface/AddOns/Blizzard_ProjectConstants/Camelot/ProjectConstants.lua ProjectConstants.lua]</code>

|}</onlyinclude>

<syntaxhighlight lang="lua">
if WOW_PROJECT_ID == WOW_PROJECT_MAINLINE then
	-- midnight
elseif WOW_PROJECT_ID == WOW_PROJECT_CAMELOT then
	-- forever
elseif WOW_PROJECT_ID == WOW_PROJECT_MISTS_CLASSIC then
	-- mists
elseif WOW_PROJECT_ID == WOW_PROJECT_BURNING_CRUSADE_CLASSIC then
	-- tbc
elseif WOW_PROJECT_ID == WOW_PROJECT_CLASSIC then
	-- vanila
end
</syntaxhighlight>
